The main takeaway from our work is that
QALYs are a useful tool for assessing the effectiveness of health care interventions, but that they are not a panacea.

, in the absence of a gold standard, it is necessary to use a range of sources to assess the impact of health care interventions on quality of life, and to use a range or sources to assign patients to health states.
